- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:~229-255 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The snapshot-only path can pass an empty or malformed `RUN_JSON` into `jq` instead of normalizing it to `{}`.
  WHY: One reviewer reported a transient API failure can break observability here, while three others said the current guard or later autofix already handles it.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:~310-316 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The final timeout branch unconditionally exits 1, so non-blocking dispatch/watch runs can still fail the job when they time out.
  WHY: Two reviewers reported fail-open/snapshot-only observability checks can be turned into release-gate failures, while others argued those paths exit earlier and the timeout branch is only reached by blocking callers.
- scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:~9-30 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `GH_API_SAFE_QUIET_STDERR` may leak from quiet-mode helper calls into later non-quiet calls in the same shell.
  WHY: Two reviewers reported the leaked flag can suppress downstream `::error::` output, while three others said inline environment assignment scopes the variable to the invoked function and it does not persist.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:34-59 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `conclusion_allowed` does not trim whitespace in the allowed-conclusions CSV, so `success, skipped` will not match `skipped`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers independently reported the space-padded CSV mismatch; one reviewer said current callers use no-space CSVs so the issue is latent.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:51-61 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `conclusion_allowed` reuses `allowed` for both the array and the loop iterator.
  WHY: One reviewer reported this as array-variable clobbering in the same function, distinct from whitespace handling.
